name: nuvora
description: Nuvora multi-vendor marketplace (modular monolith: Next.js web + NestJS API + PostgreSQL)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @nuvora/api && npm run build -w @nuvora/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @nuvora/shared && npm run test -w @nuvora/api
